R_CYCLE_K1_ONLY.note: Fallback quality is reported for the full rounded continuous partition and is diagnostic only.

R_CYCLE_PROFILE.note: Fallback quality is reported for the full rounded continuous partition and is diagnostic only.

Delta_composition.interpretation: Alternative compositions are screened without changing operation algebra; no variant is promoted from this pilot alone.

minimum.note: Fallback quality is reported for the full rounded continuous partition and is diagnostic only.

normalized_mean.note: Fallback quality is reported for the full rounded continuous partition and is diagnostic only.

product.note: Fallback quality is reported for the full rounded continuous partition and is diagnostic only.

Gamma_profile_vs_scalar.interpretation: If scalar_min loses closure or coverage relative to the cut profile, scalarization is implicated rather than Gamma as a family.

Lambda_typed_vs_scalar.interpretation: This directly tests excessive scalarization of the existing typed content-effect Lambda proxy.

scalar_norm.note: Fallback quality is reported for the full rounded continuous partition and is diagnostic only.

R_horizon.interpretation: This tests whether a single horizon is insufficient and keeps persistence separate from algebraic cycle return.

k1_only.note: Fallback quality is reported for the full rounded continuous partition and is diagnostic only.

k1_to_k4.note: Fallback quality is reported for the full rounded continuous partition and is diagnostic only.

pairwise_attribution_note: Pairwise separation is reported only for compact screen partitions, never for the nearly-injective continuous fallback.
scope_note: This is an exploratory Qwen estimator audit of Gamma, Delta, R, and Lambda at fixed OP level. Candidate estimators are not asserted to be the manuscript quantities until separately construct-validated.

selection_contract.coarseness_rule: Among admissible exploratory partitions, prefer fewer fibers before extra descriptor detail.
target_facing_metrics: AMI permutation control at fixed descriptor fiber sizes
selection_contract.warning: The pilot search is target-informed and is not a holdout promotion. AMI is evaluation-only and never defines roles, symmetries, raw component coordinates, or measurement grain.
